notes: tuning rule: every grid point replayed with frozen approve-all history; the frozen winner, its neighbouring threshold pairs (one grid step on each threshold) and the best 5 frozen points that qualify replayed with policy-specific history; the choice is the best qualifying policy-history point by the same rule; best in the searched grid: highest net contribution after the friction cost among points whose offered review minutes fit the minutes available and whose legitimate friction meets the guardrail; ties to fewer reviews, then fewer declines
